notes.title: FYR: The Lost Island Demo Launch!
notes.content:
New Name Who This?
"Project Lost Island" was always meant to be a temporary name and now were proud to finally reveal the official name: FYR: The Lost Island 

[previewyoutube=tNFoC_7Rho4;full][/previewyoutube]
It's Finally Here!
After multiple playtests and feedback rounds with our community, we've finally officially launched our demo! We're so excited for you all to try it out and discover the secrets of the island for yourself.

Playable Prequel Demo
The demo serves as a prequel to the events of the full game. You step into the shoes of Hans, a fisherman desperately attempting to escape the island as madness descends. Light becomes his only ally, not just to navigate the darkness, but to reveal the secrets of the island. Encountering eerie phenomena, discovering the fate of vanished islanders, and facing the malevolent force haunting the island, Hans' story sets the stage for the terrifying adventure ahead.


If you haven't already, feel free to join our Discord where you can chat about the game and ask the devs questions!

Don't forget to wishlist FYR: The Lost Island & leave a review to let us know what you think and how we can improve 🙏

notes.title: Project Lost Island Closed Playtest 2
notes.content:
We received a ton of great feedback last time, and we’ve tackled the most critical issues you flagged (don’t worry—we’re working on the rest too! 🙂). We’ve also completely overhauled the Lumographs (the echoes from the past) with a new visual style and method for triggering them, and recorded new character voiceovers with a new script. This is a big shift in direction, and we’re excited to hear what you think!

https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTY0dHlub2s5Mjc2anRxOWo4MXBkZ2ltNTNmaGtkMzY0YTZtenN5MiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/K6j7jvzRNr96YveK7V/giphy.gif



Joining the Playtest

The Project Lost Island Playtest will be life from April 7th - April 14th!

If you'd like to join the playtest fill out this quick form and we'll send over a key to the playtest via email.

What’s New

 More gameplay prompts to guide the player.
 Subtle highlights now show which item will be grabbed.
 Game menus and settings have been added.
 Ominous music plays when the monster is nearby.
 More bricks! (Because you can never have enough.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332286/4a8a97f7dbbc50feb2ef27dea882f6955e4ff5c8.png
Fixes and Improvements

 Grabbing is smoother—holding the crank and valve is easier, and grab range has been adjusted.
 Better stability—we’ve fixed the two known crashes we were aware of, as well as improved performance overall.
 The monster no longer camps your locker forever
 Hands won't get stuck outside the locker anymore.
 No more unexpected levitation—small debris won't launch players into the air. Sorry no more flying through the hair holding on to a wooden plank 🧹
 Doors can’t be forced open to break the level sequence anymore.

Updated

 New visual and narrative directionfor the Lumographs (ghosts).
 Full script overhaul with newly recorded voiceovers.
 Level layout tweaks to improve flow.
 Checkpoint locations adjusted for better pacing.
 Monster now sounds more intimidating.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332286/f6aec87246f5bdaa23472ce5f1c9dda1cd975005.png
Coming soon (planned, but not in this playtest)

 Teleport Locomotion
 Toggle Grab and Crouch
 Expanded content (stay tuned…)


Known Issues

 Multi-line subtitles don’t sync properly with voice lines.
 Teleport locomotion is temporarily disabled.
 Lighting bug—the flashlight and some basement lights cast incorrect shadows.


Thanks for playing, we can’t wait to hear your feedback! 👻 
Feel free to join our Discord if you want to talk directly with the team ✋

notes.title: The Future of Project Lost Island
notes.content:
It’s been a while since our last update (almost a year 😯), and we owe you a huge thanks for your patience. We've been hard at work with massive changes to the game on pretty much all levels. We have grown the team, changed the whole graphics pipeline to address performance issues, and -- last but not least -- completely overhauled the concept of the game as a whole.

Needless to say, your feedback has been pivotal for us to be able to take many of these steps and decisions. So we would like to once again thank you for the time you dedicated to playtesting and submitting your feedback!

What's New?

So what has changed? Well, simply put, everything! There is just a lot more game now. From puzzles, more story, and immersive interactions to a darker and richer story, the island has transformed into something far more sinister. 

Plus, there’s a new twist: A relentless monster is now hunting you. You’ll need every bit of stealth to survive. Duck behind cover, move cautiously, or hide beneath tables to escape its gaze!

With that being said, light & shadow still play a core part of the game and are guaranteed to immerse you in this dark, but beautiful world.

The Future of Project Lost Island

From this point on you can expect regular updates on the status of Project Lost Island! PCVR is a niche community that we believe has been underserved and needs more great games. We have ambitious goals for Project Lost Island and can only hope to achieve to them with your valuable feedback. We read and carefully consider every piece of feedback we get, it's this same input that lead to massive changes in our game over the past year. Now we need your help to take it to the finish line. 

We're still in pretty early development but we want to get our players involved as soon as possible. We're launching a closed playtest of a vertical slice we have prepared with our Discord members from March 4th to March 10th. If you'd like to join make sure to join our Discord and follow the instructions listed there. After we digest the feedback from this playtest we'll begin opening up future playtests to more and more people as we add in new content and react to feedback!

Don't forget to wishlist Project Lost Island and join our Discord to get involved in it's development!
